named_events.loss_description: The largest of the events which did occur was the earthquake in Taiwan on 3 April 2024; incurred losses were modest

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's gross claims outstanding decreased by GBP 44.9m in 2024 (a release of c.18.7% of opening gross reserves), driven primarily by favourable claims development and movements in reinsurance recoveries. The movement is reported in the technical provisions reconciliation as a gross reduction in prior year provisions. No specific quantified prior-year large-loss items were disclosed against this aggregate movement.
raw_causal_phrases: Change in estimates of prior year provisions (44,907) 12,105 (32,802)

In setting claims provisions the Syndicate gives consideration to the probability and magnitude of future experience being more adverse than assumed and exercises a degree of caution in setting reserves.
The 2022 YOA is closing by Reinsurance To Close (RITC) after 36 months with a cumulative distributable profit of GBP 59.4m (2021 YOA: GBP 45.6m).

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is taken from the Technical Provisions reconciliation table (gross column) which explicitly shows 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions'. There is an 'Other (2023 External RITC)' line in the reconciliation which may distort development metrics; RITC activity is noted in the report. The regulatory segmental table in the notes included hierarchical/grouped lines; gross_premium_mix was constructed from the Direct insurance segment (note 6) plus a single Reinsurance acceptances total to ensure sums match the total gross written premium.
